sections.label: Background
sections.help: The picture, video or color behind your windows.

fields.label: Background type
fields.help: What fills the desktop.

fields.label: Picture
fields.help: A picture from your media library.

fields.label: Change every
fields.help: The slideshow shows every picture in your media library.

fields.label: Picture fit
fields.help: How the picture fills the screen. The blurred choices fill the empty space with a blurred copy.

fields.label: Video
fields.help: A video from your media library. It loops.

fields.label: Blur the video
fields.help: Blurs the whole video, for example so desktop icons stay readable.

fields.label: Day and night videos
fields.help: Play a second video at night.

options.label: With the light or dark Plasma style

fields.label: Night video
fields.help: Played at night. Without one, the video above plays all day.

fields.label: Day starts at
fields.help: Hour of the day, 0 to 23.

fields.label: Night starts at
fields.help: Hour of the day, 0 to 23.

fields.label: Wallpaper
fields.help: One you subscribed to in Wallpaper Engine on Steam.

fields.label: Allow scene wallpapers (experimental)
fields.help: Scene wallpapers can crash the desktop. If it keeps crashing, Forge goes back to your last picture.

fields.label: Frame rate limit
fields.help: For scene and web wallpapers. Lower uses less power.

fields.label: Playback speed
fields.help: Not used by web wallpapers.

fields.label: Sound volume
fields.help: 0 keeps it muted.

fields.label: Pause the video
fields.help: When to pause, to save power while you work or play. Fullscreen games count as fullscreen.

fields.label: Pause the wallpaper
fields.help: When to pause, to save power while you work or play. Fullscreen games count as fullscreen.

fields.label: Pause on battery
fields.help: Laptops: pause while running on battery.

fields.label: Color
fields.help: For a gradient, the color it starts with.

fields.label: Second color
fields.help: The color the gradient ends with.

fields.label: Screens
fields.help: Use this background on every screen, or on one.

fields.label: Which screen
fields.help: The screen's connector, like DP-1 or HDMI-A-1.

sections.label: Dock
sections.help: The bar with your favorite apps and open windows.

fields.label: Dock style
fields.help: Default keeps your normal Plasma panel exactly as you had it. Floating clean turns that panel into a centered, see-through bar. Animated uses Krema, a separate dock whose icons grow under the mouse.

fields.label: Position
fields.help: The screen edge the dock sits on.

fields.label: Alignment
fields.help: Where the bar sits along its edge.

fields.label: Width
fields.help: Fit makes the bar only as long as its icons. Full uses the whole edge, still floating.

fields.label: Icon size
fields.help: How big the app icons are. In Floating clean this sets the bar's thickness (icons plus a small margin).

fields.label: Visibility
fields.help: Always shown, hidden until the mouse touches its edge, or hidden only while a window covers it.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: See-through, see-through until a window is maximized, or solid. Plasma takes the color, blur and corner shape from your Plasma theme.

fields.label: Plasma panel while Krema runs
fields.help: What happens to your normal Plasma panel (clock, tray, menu). The slim bar goes to the top, or to the bottom when the dock is on top. Choosing Default later puts the panel back as it was.

options.label: Slim bar on the other edge

fields.label: Zoom
fields.help: How much an icon grows under the mouse. 100% turns zoom off.

fields.label: Zoom style
fields.help: Wave: the icons next to it grow too and make room, like macOS. In place: the icon grows over its neighbors.

fields.label: Zoom speed
fields.help: How fast icons grow and shrink.

fields.label: Grow time
fields.help: Only used when Zoom speed is Custom.

fields.label: Shrink time
fields.help: Only used when Zoom speed is Custom.

fields.label: Zoom curve
fields.help: Only used when Zoom speed is Custom.

fields.label: Space between icons
fields.help: Gap between two icons.

fields.label: Corner rounding
fields.help: 0 gives square corners.

fields.label: Gap from the edge
fields.help: Space between the dock and the screen edge (or a Plasma panel on the same edge). 0 puts it right on the edge.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Theme: blurred, in your Plasma colors. Frosted: blur without the extra contrast. Tinted: one color, no blur. Transparent: icons only.

fields.label: Background opacity
fields.help: 0% is invisible, 100% is solid.

fields.label: Background color
fields.help: Theme uses your Plasma header color, Accent your accent color. Custom uses the tint color and only works with the Tinted background.

fields.label: Tint color
fields.help: Used when Background color is Custom tint and Background is Tinted.

fields.label: Shadow
fields.help: A soft shadow under the dock.

fields.label: Shadow strength
fields.help: Used when Shadow is on.

fields.label: Show delay
fields.help: With Auto hide or Dodge windows: how long the mouse waits at the edge before the dock appears.

fields.label: Hide delay
fields.help: With Auto hide or Dodge windows: how long the dock stays after the mouse leaves.

fields.label: Dodge only the active window
fields.help: With Dodge windows: hide only for the window you are using, not for every window that touches the dock.

fields.label: Keep windows off the dock
fields.help: When the dock is always visible, maximized windows stop at its edge instead of going under it.

fields.label: Badges
fields.help: Unread counts on app icons.

fields.label: Window previews
fields.help: Show a live picture of an app's windows when you point at its icon.

fields.label: Preview size
fields.help: Width of each window preview.

fields.label: When an app needs you
fields.help: How an icon moves when its app asks for attention. A bounce when an app starts is not available in Krema.

fields.label: Screens
fields.help: Show the dock on the main screen, on every screen, or on the screen you are using.

sections.label: Bootup
sections.help: What you see while the PC starts.

fields.label: Boot splash
fields.help: Shown while the PC starts, shuts down and asks for the disk password. Asks for your admin password when applied, and shows after the next restart. While it is on, system updates take a little longer.

fields.label: Boot splash picture or video
fields.help: Any picture or video. Forge turns it into at most 90 small frames (at most 480 x 480 pixels and 8 MB together).

fields.label: Boot splash animation
fields.help: Loop: plays over and over, one round every 2 seconds. Play once: moves along with the start up and stops on the last frame (at shutdown only the background shows).

fields.label: Part of the video to use
fields.help: From the start of the video. Plymouth plays a loop in 2 seconds and draws at most 30 pictures a second, so a longer part plays faster. If the frames don't fit in 8 MB, some are left out evenly: the timing stays, the motion is less smooth, and applying tells you.

fields.label: Boot splash size
fields.help: The largest side of the picture on screen, before any display scaling.

fields.label: Boot splash background
fields.help: The colour around your picture.

fields.label: Keep the PC maker's logo
fields.help: Shows the motherboard or PC maker's logo behind your picture, when the PC provides one.

fields.label: Login screen background
fields.help: Asks for your admin password when applied. Works with Plasma Login Manager only (not SDDM). A video needs the Smart Video Wallpaper plugin.

fields.label: Login screen picture or video
fields.help: Pictures are copied as PNG. Videos: MP4, WebM, MKV or MOV, up to 256 MB.

fields.label: Desktop splash after login
fields.help: The short screen while your desktop loads. Yours alone, no password needed.

fields.label: Desktop splash picture or video
fields.help: A short video works best: the splash closes as soon as the desktop is ready.

fields.label: Lock screen
fields.help: Yours alone, no password needed. A video needs the Smart Video Wallpaper plugin.

sections.label: Theme
sections.help: Colors, icons, mouse pointer, window title bars, Plasma style and fonts. Leave as it is keeps what you have now.

fields.label: Colors
fields.help: Light or dark, or any color scheme installed on this PC.

fields.label: Color scheme
fields.help: The color schemes installed on this PC.

fields.label: Accent color
fields.help: The color of selections, switches and highlights. From the wallpaper follows your background picture.

fields.label: Icons
fields.help: None chosen leaves your icons as they are.

fields.label: Mouse pointer
fields.help: None chosen leaves your pointer as it is.

fields.label: Pointer size
fields.help: If a pointer theme has no picture in this size, it uses its own size. Some apps change only after you log in again.

fields.label: Window title bars
fields.help: The frame and buttons around each window. None chosen leaves them as they are.

fields.label: Plasma style
fields.help: The look of the panel, menus and pop-ups. None chosen leaves it as it is.

fields.label: Text font
fields.help: For menus, windows and the panel. None chosen keeps your font.

fields.label: Text size
fields.help: In points. Thai text reads well at 10 or more.

fields.label: Fixed width font
fields.help: For terminals and code editors. None chosen keeps your font.

fields.label: Fixed width size
fields.help: In points.
